detail.longDescription: This is a follow on question from this thread about using the Clean Filter to remove unwanted attributes from an SSIS DTSX package when checking in to Git. I've got a basic substitution working using this filter in my git config file and referencing it in my gitattributes file:- [filter "stripvolatileattributes"] clean = sed 's/ DTS:ThreadHint=[\"][0-9]*[\"]//' smudge = cat required = true The issue now is that there are actually several different attributes I want to remove. E.g. ThreadHint, VersionBuild and VersionGUID. From what I've read on line I think I can only reference one filter per file type in gitattributes so I think that leaves me with two choices:- put multiple sed commands on the same Clean filter put multiple pattern and replace pairs on a single sed command I can't seem to work out how to do this. I've seen a few posts saying I can separate commands using a semi colon but if I separate multiple commands only the first seems to be run. I have found some examples that put multiple commands into a separate script file but I'd rather avoid that for simplicity (I'll be leaving this to be maintained by some fairly non-techy people so simplicity is very much a goal). I'm keeping it in my pocket as a fall back option though. Any ideas?
